question: How do Samanā and Śiva function together in cosmic activity?
premises: Empowered by Śiva, Samanā bears many cosmic eggs.
Śiva, mounted upon her, is the lord.
inference: Samanā supports the cosmos while Śiva, acting through her, performs the five cosmic functions.
plain_english: Empowered by Śiva, she bears many cosmic eggs. Resting upon her, Lord Śiva performs the five acts.
